name: Zodiac MyStamp Folder (Ox) with Spring Decorative MyStamp Sheet (MYOXCFDL)
page_name: Zodiac MyStamp Folder (Ox) with Spring Decorative MyStamp Sheet (MYOXCFDL)
description: Celebrate the Year  of the Ox this CNY with SingPost. This commemorative A4 MyStamp folder features a traditional ox illustration, signifying wealth and good fortune, and explains the significance of each of the zodiac animals. There’s a MyStamp sheet inside the folder featuring a stamp tab for each of the 12 animals with a large decorative stamp tab depicting ox and lucky gold ingots. An additional commemorative octagon MyStamp sheet is also included, which shows a golden ox surrounded by spring flowers and gold ingots. Start your collection now with a new zodiac animal MyStamp folder each Chinese New Year!
